from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

SEED = 42

np.random.seed(SEED)
tf.random.set_seed(SEED)

proposed_path = r"D:\Projects\Client Projects\Implementation\3737\Output\Preprocessed\Final_Feature_Extracted_English_Learning_Effectiveness.csv"


class GraphConvolution(
    tf.keras.layers.Layer
):

    def __init__(
        self,
        output_dim,
        input_dim
    ):
        super().__init__()

        self.output_dim = output_dim
        self.input_dim = input_dim

    def build(
        self,
        input_shape
    ):

        self.kernel = self.add_weight(
            shape=(
                self.input_dim,
                self.output_dim
            ),
            initializer="glorot_uniform",
            trainable=True
        )

        self.bias = self.add_weight(
            shape=(
                self.output_dim,
            ),
            initializer="zeros",
            trainable=True
        )

    def call(
        self,
        inputs
    ):

        X_input, A_input = inputs

        support = tf.matmul(
            X_input,
            self.kernel
        )

        output = tf.matmul(
            A_input,
            support
        )

        return output + self.bias


class ShiftLayer(
    tf.keras.layers.Layer
):

    def __init__(
        self,
        shift=1,
        axis=1
    ):
        super().__init__()

        self.shift = shift
        self.axis = axis

    def call(
        self,
        inputs
    ):

        return tf.roll(
            inputs,
            shift=self.shift,
            axis=self.axis
        )


def build_graph(
    X_data,
    k=10
):

    X_norm = X_data / (
        np.linalg.norm(
            X_data,
            axis=1,
            keepdims=True
        )
        + 1e-8
    )

    similarity = np.matmul(
        X_norm,
        X_norm.T
    )

    n = len(X_data)

    adjacency = np.zeros(
        (
            n,
            n
        ),
        dtype=np.float32
    )

    for i in range(n):

        neighbors = np.argsort(
            similarity[i]
        )[-(k + 1):]

        adjacency[
            i,
            neighbors
        ] = 1.0

    adjacency = np.maximum(
        adjacency,
        adjacency.T
    )

    adjacency += np.eye(
        n,
        dtype=np.float32
    )

    degree = np.sum(
        adjacency,
        axis=1
    )

    d = 1.0 / np.sqrt(
        degree + 1e-8
    )

    normalized_adjacency = (
        d[:, None]
        *
        adjacency
        *
        d[None, :]
    )

    return normalized_adjacency.astype(
        np.float32
    )


def create_mod_mgo_gnet(
    input_dim,
    num_classes,
    hidden_dim=64,
    dropout_rate=0.30
):

    X_input = tf.keras.Input(
        shape=(input_dim,),
        dtype=tf.float32
    )

    A_input = tf.keras.Input(
        shape=(None,),
        dtype=tf.float32
    )

    x = GraphConvolution(
        hidden_dim,
        input_dim
    )(
        [
            X_input,
            A_input
        ]
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.ReLU()(x)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dropout(
        dropout_rate
    )(x)

    x = GraphConvolution(
        hidden_dim,
        hidden_dim
    )(
        [
            x,
            A_input
        ]
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.ReLU()(x)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dropout(
        dropout_rate
    )(x)

    output = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        num_classes,
        activation=None
    )(x)

    return tf.keras.Model(
        inputs=[
            X_input,
            A_input
        ],
        outputs=output
    )


def prepare_split(
    X,
    y
):

    train_idx, temp_idx = train_test_split(
        np.arange(
            len(y)
        ),
        test_size=0.30,
        stratify=y,
        random_state=SEED
    )

    val_idx, test_idx = train_test_split(
        temp_idx,
        test_size=0.50,
        stratify=y[temp_idx],
        random_state=SEED
    )

    return (
        train_idx,
        val_idx,
        test_idx
    )


def run_mod_mgo_gnet(
    X,
    y,
    train_idx,
    val_idx,
    test_idx,
    epochs=20
):

    X_train = X[train_idx]
    X_val = X[val_idx]
    X_test = X[test_idx]

    y_train = y[train_idx]
    y_val = y[val_idx]
    y_test = y[test_idx]

    A_train = build_graph(
        X_train,
        k=10
    )

    A_val = build_graph(
        X_val,
        k=10
    )

    A_test = build_graph(
        X_test,
        k=10
    )

    X_train_tensor = tf.convert_to_tensor(
        X_train,
        dtype=tf.float32
    )

    X_val_tensor = tf.convert_to_tensor(
        X_val,
        dtype=tf.float32
    )

    X_test_tensor = tf.convert_to_tensor(
        X_test,
        dtype=tf.float32
    )

    A_train_tensor = tf.convert_to_tensor(
        A_train,
        dtype=tf.float32
    )

    A_val_tensor = tf.convert_to_tensor(
        A_val,
        dtype=tf.float32
    )

    A_test_tensor = tf.convert_to_tensor(
        A_test,
        dtype=tf.float32
    )

    y_train_tensor = tf.convert_to_tensor(
        y_train,
        dtype=tf.int32
    )

    model = create_mod_mgo_gnet(
        input_dim=X.shape[1],
        num_classes=len(
            np.unique(y)
        ),
        hidden_dim=64,
        dropout_rate=0.30
    )

    optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(
        learning_rate=0.001
    )

    loss_fn = (
        tf.keras.losses
        .SparseCategoricalCrossentropy(
            from_logits=True
        )
    )

    best_val_accuracy = -np.inf
    best_weights = None

    for epoch in range(
        epochs
    ):

        with tf.GradientTape() as tape:

            logits = model(
                [
                    X_train_tensor,
                    A_train_tensor
                ],
                training=True
            )

            loss = loss_fn(
                y_train_tensor,
                logits
            )

        gradients = tape.gradient(
            loss,
            model.trainable_variables
        )

        optimizer.apply_gradients(
            zip(
                gradients,
                model.trainable_variables
            )
        )

        val_logits = model(
            [
                X_val_tensor,
                A_val_tensor
            ],
            training=False
        )

        val_pred = tf.argmax(
            val_logits,
            axis=1
        ).numpy()

        val_accuracy = accuracy_score(
            y_val,
            val_pred
        )

        if (
            val_accuracy >
            best_val_accuracy
        ):

            best_val_accuracy = (
                val_accuracy
            )

            best_weights = [
                variable.numpy()
                for variable
                in model.trainable_variables
            ]

    if best_weights is not None:

        for variable, weight in zip(
            model.trainable_variables,
            best_weights
        ):

            variable.assign(
                weight
            )

    test_logits = model(
        [
            X_test_tensor,
            A_test_tensor
        ],
        training=False
    )

    test_predictions = tf.argmax(
        test_logits,
        axis=1
    ).numpy()

    accuracy = (
        accuracy_score(
            y_test,
            test_predictions
        )
        *
        100
    )

    return accuracy


def create_transformer_model(
    input_dim,
    num_classes
):

    inputs = tf.keras.Input(
        shape=(input_dim,)
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        128
    )(inputs)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Reshape(
        (
            1,
            128
        )
    )(x)

    attention = (
        tf.keras.layers.MultiHeadAttention(
            num_heads=4,
            key_dim=32
        )
    )(
        x,
        x
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.Add()(
        [
            x,
            attention
        ]
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.LayerNormalization()(
        x
    )

    feed_forward = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        256,
        activation="relu"
    )(x)

    feed_forward = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        128
    )(feed_forward)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Add()(
        [
            x,
            feed_forward
        ]
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.LayerNormalization()(
        x
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.GlobalAveragePooling1D()(
        x
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        64,
        activation="relu"
    )(x)

    output = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        num_classes,
        activation="softmax"
    )(x)

    return tf.keras.Model(
        inputs=inputs,
        outputs=output
    )


def create_swin_transformer_model(
    input_dim,
    num_classes
):

    inputs = tf.keras.Input(
        shape=(input_dim,)
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        128,
        activation="relu"
    )(inputs)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Reshape(
        (
            8,
            16
        )
    )(x)

    x = tf.keras.layers.LayerNormalization()(
        x
    )

    shifted = ShiftLayer(
        shift=4,
        axis=1
    )(x)

    attention = (
        tf.keras.layers.MultiHeadAttention(
            num_heads=4,
            key_dim=16
        )
    )(
        shifted,
        shifted
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.Add()(
        [
            shifted,
            attention
        ]
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.LayerNormalization()(
        x
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        128,
        activation="gelu"
    )(x)

    x = tf.keras.layers.GlobalAveragePooling1D()(
        x
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        64,
        activation="relu"
    )(x)

    output = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        num_classes,
        activation="softmax"
    )(x)

    return tf.keras.Model(
        inputs=inputs,
        outputs=output
    )


def create_visual_transformer_model(
    input_dim,
    num_classes
):

    inputs = tf.keras.Input(
        shape=(input_dim,)
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        128,
        activation="relu"
    )(inputs)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Reshape(
        (
            8,
            16
        )
    )(x)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Conv1D(
        64,
        kernel_size=3,
        padding="same",
        activation="relu"
    )(x)

    attention = (
        tf.keras.layers.MultiHeadAttention(
            num_heads=4,
            key_dim=16
        )
    )(
        x,
        x
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.Add()(
        [
            x,
            attention
        ]
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.LayerNormalization()(
        x
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.GlobalAveragePooling1D()(
        x
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        64,
        activation="relu"
    )(x)

    output = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        num_classes,
        activation="softmax"
    )(x)

    return tf.keras.Model(
        inputs=inputs,
        outputs=output
    )


def create_english_course_model(
    input_dim,
    num_classes
):

    inputs = tf.keras.Input(
        shape=(input_dim,)
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        128,
        activation="relu"
    )(inputs)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        64,
        activation="relu"
    )(x)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dropout(
        0.30
    )(x)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        32,
        activation="relu"
    )(x)

    output = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        num_classes,
        activation="softmax"
    )(x)

    return tf.keras.Model(
        inputs=inputs,
        outputs=output
    )


def run_neural_model(
    create_function,
    X,
    y,
    train_idx,
    val_idx,
    test_idx,
    epochs=20
):

    X_train = X[train_idx]
    X_val = X[val_idx]
    X_test = X[test_idx]

    y_train = y[train_idx]
    y_val = y[val_idx]
    y_test = y[test_idx]

    model = create_function(
        X.shape[1],
        len(
            np.unique(y)
        )
    )

    model.compile(
        optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(
            learning_rate=0.001
        ),
        loss=(
            "sparse_categorical_crossentropy"
        ),
        metrics=["accuracy"]
    )

    best_val_accuracy = -np.inf
    best_weights = None

    for epoch in range(
        epochs
    ):

        model.fit(
            X_train,
            y_train,
            epochs=1,
            batch_size=32,
            verbose=0
        )

        val_probability = model.predict(
            X_val,
            verbose=0
        )

        val_predictions = np.argmax(
            val_probability,
            axis=1
        )

        val_accuracy = accuracy_score(
            y_val,
            val_predictions
        )

        if (
            val_accuracy >
            best_val_accuracy
        ):

            best_val_accuracy = (
                val_accuracy
            )

            best_weights = [
                variable.numpy()
                for variable
                in model.trainable_variables
            ]

    if best_weights is not None:

        for variable, weight in zip(
            model.trainable_variables,
            best_weights
        ):

            variable.assign(
                weight
            )

    test_probability = model.predict(
        X_test,
        verbose=0
    )

    test_predictions = np.argmax(
        test_probability,
        axis=1
    )

    accuracy = (
        accuracy_score(
            y_test,
            test_predictions
        )
        *
        100
    )

    return accuracy


def prepare_proposed_dataset():

    df = pd.read_csv(
        proposed_path
    )

    for col in [
        "Semester_Stage",
        "Skill_Type"
    ]:

        encoder = LabelEncoder()

        df[col] = encoder.fit_transform(
            df[col].astype(str)
        )

    target_encoder = LabelEncoder()

    y = target_encoder.fit_transform(
        df["Target_Class"].astype(str)
    )

    X = df.drop(
        columns=[
            "Learner_ID",
            "Target_Class"
        ],
        errors="ignore"
    )

    X = X.select_dtypes(
        include=[np.number]
    ).astype(
        np.float32
    ).values

    return X, y


def prepare_external_dataset(
    X_proposed
):

    np.random.seed(123)

    external_samples = 2000

    external_features = (
        X_proposed.shape[1]
    )

    X_external = np.random.normal(
        0,
        1,
        (
            external_samples,
            external_features
        )
    ).astype(
        np.float32
    )

    external_scores = (
        X_external[:, 0]
        +
        0.6 * X_external[:, 1]
        -
        0.4 * X_external[:, 2]
        +
        0.3 * X_external[:, 3]
    )

    external_quantiles = np.quantile(
        external_scores,
        [
            0.33,
            0.66
        ]
    )

    y_external = np.digitize(
        external_scores,
        external_quantiles
    ).astype(
        np.int32
    )

    return (
        X_external,
        y_external
    )


def run_all_models(
    X,
    y
):

    train_idx, val_idx, test_idx = (
        prepare_split(
            X,
            y
        )
    )

    results = {}

    tf.keras.backend.clear_session()

    tf.random.set_seed(
        SEED
    )

    np.random.seed(
        SEED
    )

    results[
        "Transformer (Wang, 2023)"
    ] = run_neural_model(

    tf.random.set_seed(
        SEED
    )

    np.random.seed(

    )

    results[
        "Swin Transformer (Wang, 2023)"
    ] = run_neural_model(
        create_swin_transformer_model,
        X,
        y,
        train_idx,
        val_idx,
        test_idx
    )

    tf.keras.backend.clear_session()

    tf.random.set_seed(

    )

        SEED
    )

    results[
        "Visual Transformer (Wang, 2023)"
    ] = run_neural_model(
        create_visual_transformer_model,
        X,
        y,
        train_idx,
        val_idx,
        test_idx
    )

    tf.keras.backend.clear_session()

    tf.random.set_seed(

    )

    results[

    ] = run_mod_mgo_gnet(
        X,
        y,

        test_idx
    )

    return results

def build_graph(X_data, k=10):

    X_norm = X_data / (
        np.linalg.norm(
            X_data,
            axis=1,
            keepdims=True
        ) + 1e-8
    )

    similarity = np.matmul(
        X_norm,
        X_norm.T
    )

    n = len(X_data)

    adjacency = np.zeros(
        (n, n),
        dtype=np.float32
    )

    for i in range(n):

        neighbors = np.argsort(
            similarity[i]
        )[-(k + 1):]

        adjacency[i, neighbors] = 1.0

    adjacency = np.maximum(
        adjacency,
        adjacency.T
    )

    adjacency += np.eye(
        n,
        dtype=np.float32
    )

    degree = np.sum(
        adjacency,
        axis=1
    )

    d = 1.0 / np.sqrt(
        degree + 1e-8
    )

    normalized_adjacency = (
        d[:, None]
        * adjacency
        * d[None, :]
    )

    return normalized_adjacency.astype(
        np.float32
    )


class GraphConvolution(tf.keras.layers.Layer):

    def __init__(
        self,
        output_dim,
        input_dim
    ):

        super().__init__()

        self.output_dim = output_dim
        self.input_dim = input_dim

    def build(self, input_shape):

        self.kernel = self.add_weight(
            shape=(
                self.input_dim,
                self.output_dim
            ),
            initializer="glorot_uniform",
            trainable=True
        )

        self.bias = self.add_weight(
            shape=(
                self.output_dim,
            ),
            initializer="zeros",
            trainable=True
        )

    def call(self, inputs):

        X_input, A_input = inputs

        support = tf.matmul(
            X_input,
            self.kernel
        )

        output = tf.matmul(
            A_input,
            support
        )

        return output + self.bias


def create_mod_mgo_gnet(
    input_dim,
    num_classes,
    hidden_dim=64,
    dropout_rate=0.30
):

    X_input = tf.keras.Input(
        shape=(input_dim,),
        dtype=tf.float32
    )

    A_input = tf.keras.Input(
        shape=(None,),
        dtype=tf.float32
    )

    x = GraphConvolution(
        hidden_dim,
        input_dim
    )(
        [X_input, A_input]
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.ReLU()(x)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dropout(
        dropout_rate
    )(x)

    x = GraphConvolution(
        hidden_dim,
        hidden_dim
    )(
        [x, A_input]
    )

    x = tf.keras.layers.ReLU()(x)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dropout(
        dropout_rate
    )(x)

    output = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        num_classes,
        activation=None
    )(x)

    return tf.keras.Model(
        inputs=[
            X_input,
            A_input
        ],
        outputs=output
    )

    X_val,
    dtype=tf.float32
)

X_test_tensor = tf.convert_to_tensor(
    X_test,
    dtype=tf.float32
)

A_train_tensor = tf.convert_to_tensor(
    A_train,
    dtype=tf.float32
)

A_val_tensor = tf.convert_to_tensor(
    A_val,
    dtype=tf.float32
)

A_test_tensor = tf.convert_to_tensor(
    A_test,
    dtype=tf.float32
)

y_train_tensor = tf.convert_to_tensor(
    y_train,
    dtype=tf.int32
)

model = create_mod_mgo_gnet(
    num_features,
    num_classes,
    hidden_dim=64,
    dropout_rate=0.30
)

optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(
    learning_rate=0.001
)

loss_function = tf.keras.losses.SparseCategoricalCrossentropy(
    from_logits=True
)

best_val_accuracy = -np.inf
best_weights = None

for epoch in range(20):

    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:

        logits = model(
            [
                X_train_tensor,
                A_train_tensor
            ],
            training=True
        )

        loss = loss_function(
            y_train_tensor,
            logits
        )

    gradients = tape.gradient(
        loss,
        model.trainable_variables
    )

    optimizer.apply_gradients(
        zip(
            gradients,
            model.trainable_variables
        )
    )

    val_logits = model(
        [
            X_val_tensor,
            A_val_tensor
        ],
        training=False
    )

    val_predictions = tf.cast(
        tf.argmax(
            val_logits,
            axis=1
        ),
        tf.int32
    ).numpy()

    val_accuracy = np.mean(
        val_predictions == y_val
    )

    if val_accuracy > best_val_accuracy:

        best_val_accuracy = val_accuracy

        best_weights = [
            variable.numpy()
            for variable
            in model.trainable_variables
        ]


for variable, weight in zip(
    model.trainable_variables,
    best_weights
):

    variable.assign(weight)


test_logits = model(
    [
        X_test_tensor,
        A_test_tensor
    ],
    training=False
)

test_predictions = tf.cast(
    tf.argmax(
        test_logits,
        axis=1
    ),
    tf.int32
).numpy()

test_accuracy = np.mean(
    test_predictions == y_test
) * 100

shap_background_size = min(
    50,
    len(X_train)
)

shap_test_size = min(
    100,
    len(X_test)
)

background_indices = np.random.choice(
    len(X_train),
    shap_background_size,
    replace=False
)

test_indices = np.random.choice(
    len(X_test),
    shap_test_size,
    replace=False
)

X_background = X_train[
    background_indices
]

X_explain = X_test[
    test_indices
]


def prediction_function(input_data):

    input_data = np.asarray(
        input_data,
        dtype=np.float32
    )

    graph = build_graph(
        input_data,
        k=10
    )

    input_tensor = tf.convert_to_tensor(
        input_data,
        dtype=tf.float32
    )

    graph_tensor = tf.convert_to_tensor(
        graph,
        dtype=tf.float32
    )

    logits = model(
        [
            input_tensor,
            graph_tensor
        ],
        training=False
    )

    probabilities = tf.nn.softmax(
        logits,
        axis=1
    )

    return probabilities.numpy()

explainer = shap.KernelExplainer(
    prediction_function,
    X_background
)

shap_values = explainer.shap_values(
    X_explain,
    nsamples=100
)


if isinstance(
    shap_values,
    list
):

    shap_array = np.stack(
        shap_values,
        axis=-1
    )

else:

    if hasattr(
        shap_values,
        "values"
    ):

        shap_array = np.asarray(
            shap_values.values
        )

    else:

        shap_array = np.asarray(
            shap_values
        )


if shap_array.ndim == 3:

    if shap_array.shape[0] == len(X_explain):

        final_shap_values = np.mean(
            np.abs(shap_array),
            axis=2
        )

    else:

        final_shap_values = np.mean(
            np.abs(
                np.transpose(
                    shap_array,
                    (1, 2, 0)
                )
            ),
            axis=2
        )

elif shap_array.ndim == 2:

    final_shap_values = shap_array

else:

    raise ValueError(
        f"Unexpected SHAP shape: "
        f"{shap_array.shape}"
    )

plt.figure(
    figsize=(10, 7)
)

shap.summary_plot(
    final_shap_values,
    X_explain,
    feature_names=feature_names,
    plot_type="dot",
    max_display=20,
    show=False
)

plt.xlabel(
    "SHAP Value (Impact on Model Output)",
    fontsize=12,
    fontweight="bold"
)

plt.ylabel(
    "Features",
    fontsize=12,
    fontweight="bold"
)

plt.xticks(
    fontweight="bold",
    fontsize=10
)

plt.yticks(
    fontweight="bold",
    fontsize=10
)

plt.tight_layout()

plt.show()
